ns2:course.label: Independent Study
ns2:course.description: Independent guided study and investigation in a selected area of architecture. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in the same or separate semesters to a maximum of 12 hours, if topics vary. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in Architecture, written proposal approved by a sponsoring faculty member and the approval of the Director of Graduate Studies.
